messages.content:
Rewrite these unverified audio-model observations into non-speech captions
for Deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers. These observations are the ONLY factual input;
do not add sounds, source identities, emotion, visuals, plot or interpretations.
Do not treat observations as independently verified. Remove speculative causes
or moods. Preserve multiple audible sound types. Three texts per observation:
essential (short labels), balanced (brief description), detailed (more of the
already supplied acoustic detail, at most 25 words). All <= 278 characters, no
brackets, markup or newlines. If the observation explicitly reports no non-speech
sounds, return null texts for that id. Return only a JSON object with key captions,
an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, detailed. Preserve
every input id exactly once. Do not generate timestamps. Observations:
[{"id": "315", "observation": "A series of sharp, metallic impacts and scraping sounds occur, followed by a brief, high-pitched electronic tone."}, {"id": "345", "observation": "A sharp pop, a loud explosion, a brief laugh, and a musical jingle are heard, followed by a second explosion and a final musical jingle."}, {"id": "360", "observation": "A cat meows, followed by a dog barking, then a cat meowing again, with background bird chirping and a sudden loud bang."}, {"id": "390", "observation": "A door opens, followed by a low hum, then a dramatic orchestral score with strings, brass, and percussion."}, {"id": "405", "observation": "A dramatic orchestral score with sweeping strings, brass fanfare, and impactful sound effects like whooshes and metallic clangs."}, {"id": "435", "observation": "A dramatic orchestral score with sharp metallic impacts, a high-pitched scream, and a final electronic beep."}, {"id": "450", "observation": "A series of electronic beeps, a high-pitched squeak, and a sustained, low-pitched musical tone are audible."}, {"id": "480", "observation": "A dramatic orchestral score with prominent strings and percussion builds tension, culminating in a powerful, sustained chord."}]
